protocol.previous_goal_turn: progress:e9b268e froze C68-C70 with independent decoder audits;formal goal unmet
protocol.fit: Same original balanced-v2 sampler:500/condition,30min spacing,eventseed20261013. Fit only registered dates;checkpoint15days unused buffer.
protocol.baseline: Refit existing strong recipe:plain/rich causal tree600/63 seed20261013;all eligible six-step rows. Decision chooses stronger calibrated arm,plain on tie.
protocol.onset: For BOTH feature arms before decision:two classifier seeds20261013/20261029,600/63,lr.035,minchild60,lambda8,colsample.9,unit weights;only fit onset eligible T+30 rows. No ranker/count/neural refit.
protocol.decision: 30days,eventseed4133. Same chosen baseline feature arm for onset;equal two-seed mean. Threshold31 values.05..8 x forceFalse/True,prefer noforce/closer.5. Fixedk1/2/4/8/16 is matched secondary only.
protocol.primary_choice: Decision chooses only incumbent or threshold,incumbent on tie. Later15day selection gate gain>=.01,7dayblockCI lower>0;otherwise incumbent. No assessment retuning.
protocol.evaluation_sampling: Balanced30/condition,360min spacing. Deduplicate physical origins across event seeds for comparisons.
protocol.assessment: 30days,read after selection seal. Public development dates have appeared in other studies;new fit calendars/weights,NOT blind/new public data/final/private.
protocol.cross_case: Descriptive evidence requires>=2case gain>=.01 and lowerCI>0,no case loss>.01. Cases share dates/fit inputs;not independent repetitions.
